question: What is the theme of the 2019 International Day of UN Peacekeepers?

options.text: Investing in Peace around the world

solution:
The correct answer is __**Protecting Civilians, Protecting Peace**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The theme for the 2019 International Day of UN Peacekeepers was **“Protecting Civilians, Protecting Peace”**.
 
• This theme highlights the crucial role played by UN peacekeepers in providing security and supporting the political process in countries torn by conflict.
 
• Peacekeepers are often deployed in situations where civilians are at risk, and their presence can help to deter violence and protect vulnerable populations.
 
• The theme also underscores the importance of peacekeeping missions in establishing and maintaining peace in conflict-affected areas, which is essential for sustainable development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Day of United Nations Peacekeepers**

 
 
• The International Day of United Nations Peacekeepers is observed annually on May 29th.
 
• It was established by the UN General Assembly in 2002 to pay tribute to all the men and women who have served and continue to serve in UN peacekeeping operations.
 
• The day also honors the memory of those who have lost their lives in the cause of peace.
 
 
 
• **UN Peacekeeping**
 
 
• UN peacekeeping is a collective security measure aimed at maintaining peace and security in conflict areas.
 
• It involves the deployment of military, police, and civilian personnel from UN member states to conflict zones.
 
• The primary functions of UN peacekeepers include monitoring ceasefires, protecting civilians, disarming former combatants, supporting the organization of elections, and promoting human rights and the rule of law.
 
• Peacekeeping missions are authorized by the UN Security Council and are typically established with the consent of the host government.
 
 
 
• **Protecting Civilians**
 
 
• Protecting civilians is a fundamental mandate of many UN peacekeeping operations.
 
• This involves using force, if necessary, to protect civilians from imminent threat of physical violence.
 
• Peacekeepers also work to create a secure environment for the delivery of humanitarian aid and the safe return of displaced persons.
